<thought>The mass spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope: the M+1 peak is ~11% of the monoisotopic, M+2 ~0.5%, M+3 ~0.016%, etc., matching the binomial distribution for ~10 carbons. No other element’s characteristic isotope pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) is evident. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
